# `docs/parity.md` feature rows contradict master

**Problem.** The summary table is regenerated by each merge train, but the hand-written
feature rows are not. Rows marked ❌ that master fixes (found by the 0221 scout,
2026-10-18, against master b0fb0ef): boolean and list printing (0012 done), the tests
section (0017), namespace (0042), lexical macros (0038), `range` with a negative step,
`cycler`/`joiner`/`lipsum` (0030), and the rows for 0044 and 0026. `{{ True }}` prints
`True` on master while the page says it prints `true`. The page is the public answer to
"what differs from Jinja2" and the website will render it (0244).

**Proposal.** Walk every ❌/🟡 row, re-check it with a corpus case or the oracle, and either
fix the row or cite the open task or divergence line that explains it. Add a check
(a script run in the format job) that fails when a row cites a task whose status is `done`
or when a ❌/🟡 row cites no task.

**Done when.** Every ❌/🟡 row cites an open task or a divergence line, the check runs in
CI, and the rows above are corrected.
